x_vals = [num('Knot measurements', f'B{r}') for r in rows]
y_vals = [num('Knot measurements', f'C{r}') for r in rows]
sorted_pairs = sorted(zip(x_vals, y_vals))
# integrate from x=0 to x=21 using trapezoidal rule on piecewise linear interpolation
# knots are at x=0,3,8,14,21
# filter x between 0 and 21
pts = [(x, y) for x, y in sorted_pairs if 0 <= x <= 21]
# integrate
integral = 0.0
for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
    x1, y1 = pts[i]
    x2, y2 = pts[i+1]
    integral += 0.5 * (y1 + y2) * (x2 - x1)
result = round(integral, 2)
